# Reduced Motion

One motion token: a page can add the restriction, never override the OS.

In `library/components/motion-preferences/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-switch`, `.ac-motion-scope`

## ARIA

- **the toggle** — `aria-describedby`
- **the drawn track** — `aria-hidden=true`
- **the readout that reports which way it resolved** — `role=status`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — native: reaches the switch and every button on the page
- `Space` — toggles the checkbox behind the switch
- `Enter` — native: activates a focused button, and never toggles the switch — a checkbox ignores it

**States:** reducing, not reducing — the absence of the attribute

## Goes wrong when

- [data-motion="on"], which beats the media query and leaves the toggle unable to describe the page
- matchMedia read for the value, which cannot see the page’s own toggle
- the distance gated as well as the duration, so a state change becomes a jump cut
- a loop past five seconds with no pause control (SC 2.2.2), whatever the motion setting
- the two rules at different specificity, which turns source order into an accident

**API:** `AC.createMotionPreferences(root, options) -> { allowed, set, refresh, input, destroy }`
